doc.title: Scott Yanow interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 22, 2021

title: Favorite jazz artists
summary: Louis Armstrong is his favorite; Ellington, Parker, Gillespie, Miles and Coltrane are the most important, with hundreds more.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Do you have a short list of your favorite jazz artists?

Well it wouldn’t be short of course, you know I can name a bunch. I think there are certain — my favorites who — well Louis Armstrong is my favorite of all of them. You know he’s my favorite jazz artist and there’s so much joy in his playing from all aspects of his career, any period. I love the way he phrases and the sound. But if I were to name two — the ones I think are the obvious ones that are the most important to jazz history there’d be six: Louis Armstrong, Duke Ellington, Charlie Parker, Dizzy Gillespie, Miles Davis and John Coltrane. I don’t think anybody’s going to argue too much with that. You

can add another dozen to that from Ornette Coleman, maybe Chick Corea and Count Basie and you know, many, many others. But basically I have hundreds of favorites. So you’d have to say what time period.
